en.label: [section] Assessment methods:
en.content: To complete the course, it is necessary to obtain credit for the preparation and presentation of two seminar papers. Seminar papers are in the form of ppt presentations, focused on working with literary sources. The exam has a written form of six open-ended questions (each worth five points, from which a minimum of 17 points must be obtained.
